facts.fact: The interior ministry says several national management information systems are already built and in operation over its intranet for decision-makers at every level, communes included, sharing information in real time, with the primary-schools system SI-SSEP marked deployed and others still being deployed; it gives no date, so the page's publication date is used.

The interior ministry lists, among services delivered at commune counters, an electronic civil-status counter on a national automated civil-status register that lets a citizen obtain any civil-status document in real time from any commune; it gives no date or count of communes, so the page's publication date is used.

The interior ministry says the information systems it provides to communes, dairas, wilayas and the centre are put into operation 'via the MICLAT intranet network', the ministry's own network; it does not say how each commune is linked or who pays, and gives no date, so the page's publication date is used.

The interior ministry presents the intranet and the systems run over it at commune, daira, wilaya and central level as its own modernisation programme, launched under the government's action plans; no partner or vendor is named and no date is given, so the page's publication date is used.

The interior ministry states a four-axis modernisation strategy whose third axis is providing management information systems to decision-makers at all levels, communes included, over its intranet; the page gives no cost, period or coverage target and no date, so its publication date is used.
